claims.text: Basic metabolic panel: low sodium, potassium, chloride or glucose; metabolic acidosis (laxatives) or alkalosis (vomiting); acute kidney injury.
claims.quote: Basic metabolic panel Decreased sodium (water-loading), potassium, chloride, glucose; indications of metabolic acidosis (laxatives) or alkalosis (vomiting); acute renal injury

claims.text: Calcium, magnesium and phosphorus: look for low levels.
claims.quote: Calcium Decreased Cholesterol Increased Complete blood count Bone marrow hypoplasia (thrombocytopenia, anemia, leukopenia) Magnesium Decreased Phosphorus Decreased
Complete blood count Bone marrow hypoplasia (thrombocytopenia, anemia, leukopenia)

claims.text: Amylase: raised levels may suggest purging.
Thyroid tests: sick euthyroid pattern (low thyroxine or triiodothyronine without overt hypothyroidism).
claims.quote: Thyroid testing Sick euthyroid syndrome (decreased thyroxine or triiodothyronine without overt hypothyroidism)
Electrocardiography Bradycardia, arrhythmias (heart failure, electrolyte disorders), prolongation of the corrected QT interval

claims.text: Orthostatic vital signs: hypotension or tachycardia.
claims.quote: Orthostatic vital signs Hypotension, tachycardia (may suggest dehydration or autonomic instability)

claims.text: DEXA with a history of long-bone or stress fracture, amenorrhea for more than six months, or hypogonadism.
claims.quote: †—Generally indicated if there is a history of long bone or stress fracture, amenorrhea for more than six months, or hypogonadism.

claims.text: Medical causes of weight loss to exclude: malabsorption (IBD, celiac disease), new-onset type 1 diabetes, adrenal insufficiency, cancer.
claims.quote: Disorders to consider include malabsorption syndromes (eg, due to inflammatory bowel disease or celiac disease), new-onset type 1 diabetes, adrenal insufficiency, and cancer.
